title: evolve task-set v1
description: The task-set partitions for the evolution loop (master §5.4): the D_train/D_val split with D_val frozen per cycle — evalset_version stamps the frozen split, and scores are never compared across versions — plus the held-out T_test reservation for final reporting. d_train and t_test may be empty; d_val carries at least one case, and no case id may sit in two splits.
